title.en: Exempting All Gifts, Bequests, Donations And/Or Contributions to the Gintong Alay Educational and Fund Campaign From Certain Taxes and Providing Tax Allowance Therefor

text.en:
Any provision of law, decree, rules and regulations be the contrary notwithstanding, all gifts,
bequests, donations and/or contributions to the Gintong Alay Educational and Fund Campaign shall be exempt
from donor's and estate taxes and shall be deductible in full in computing the taxable net income of the donor.

All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed,
amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
